svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ScopeWatch product architecture
svg.desc: Left-to-right flow. Guild.ai hosts target and control agents plus an LLM investigator and emits native security_event ALLOW/DENY records. The ScopeWatch evidence pipeline collects, binds each event to its acting agent and canonicalizes all versions. ClickHouse stores sealed generations with exact readback, runs all-candidate (T-600s, T] window SQL at every anchor and returns query receipts, checked by an independent oracle. The operator console shows a case of subject versus control and a human approves the exact scope. A human applies a DENY rule in the Guild.ai UI, then fresh probes confirm the target is refused and the control still works, and the result returns to the case. Semgrep scans the ScopeWatch codebase as a separate shift-left lane. A replay and contract-test harness is a dev and test input.
svg.text: Find which agent exceeded its credential scope, prove it with ClickHouse, and verify the fix on Guild.ai.
